thread:
incident_bot: PAGING: runtime cluster rwd-serve-2 reported sustained GPU paging > 30% for 3m, alert severity=P2. Auto-pager invoked.

oncall_ash: saw the alert, I'm pausing noncritical deploys to that pool. taking lead.

sre_maya: copying in. can someone share a quick customer-impact summary (which routes, traffic %) so we can triage scope? :mag:

sales_jon: tied to /api/embed and a handful of power users. roughly 8% of traffic, some tail latencies > 10s hitting customers A & B. CS notified.

eng_runtime_lee: capturing initial metrics: memory RSS creeping on GPUs, KV cache growth per-session looks abnormal after a large spike around 08:12 UTC. posting immediate snapshot and a short command we ran.

eng_runtime_lee: ```bash
# quick check run by oncall
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,memory.used,memory.total,utilization.gpu --format=csv -i 0
index, memory.used [MiB], memory.total [MiB], utilization.gpu [%]
0, 14296 MiB, 16384 MiB, 98 %
1, 15040 MiB, 16384 MiB, 96 %
# runtime kvcache stats (from /metrics/runtime_kvcache)
kv_total_entries: 3.2M
kv_evictions_total: 120
kv_swap_count: 0
kv_hit_ratio_5m: 0.86
```

oncall_ash: thanks. no swap to host observed (kv_swap_count=0). that's suspicious given memory pressure.

sre_maya: adding structure — HYPOTHESES so we can vote and track in-thread:
H1: KV cache growth from long-lived websockets + missing eviction due to recent change in policy (high confidence)
H2: Batch-size or routing bump increased per-request working set causing checkpointing into GPU memory (medium)
H3: Kernel-level fragmentation from sporadic allocations in new quantized kernels (low)

eng_runtime_lee: I suspect H1 + H2. earlier today we rolled a canary that upped default dynamic_batch_size from 6 -> 12 for throughput. that would multiply KV cache usage for multi-turn sessions.

ops_patricia: immediate mitigations I'm applying now (will run sequentially canary -> scale):
- reduce dynamic_batch_size to 6 on 10% canary hosts
- enable aggressive_kvcache_evict=true (threshold 0.6) on the canary
- enable soft-eviction (host-side spill) for kvcache on 2 nodes
I will post progress.

eng_runtime_lee: commands I'm running for the canary:```bash
# rollback batch size on group canary-2
rwctl deploy-config set --pool rwd-serve-2 --label canary-2 --dynamic_batch_size 6
# enable eviction policy
rwctl runtime-config set --pool rwd-serve-2 --eviction aggressive_kvcache=1 --target canary-2
```

oncall_ash: executing now. tagging this mitigation in timeline.

incident_bot: Mitigation executed: reduced batch_size canary-2 @ 3955554401, eviction policy toggled @ 3955554412.

sre_maya: watching telemetry — paging dropped from 34% -> 12% within 90s on canary nodes. latency p50 improved, p95 trimming but still elevated.

eng_runtime_lee: can folks paste a couple of relevant logs into gs://redwood-incident-logs/3955554321/ — especially runtime agent logs and kvcache debug dumps. I'll pull and start a timeline.

cs_rita: logged CS notes: customers A & B experiencing 5-12s tail latencies, intermittent 500s reported. escalated to their engineering contacts.

sales_jon: adding commercial impact: two paying tenants saw errors; potential for credits if SLA violated. keep me in loop.

eng_runtime_lee: preliminary timeline for RCA work (will expand):
- 08:11: deploy canary with dynamic_batch_size=12 started (automated rollout)
- 08:12: traffic spike (external) + sessions opened -> kv_total_entries spike
- 08:14: paging alerts begin, p95 latency rising
- 08:16: incident auto-pager fires, oncall takes lead
- 08:18: mitigations (batch rollback + eviction enable) started
- 08:19: canary paging drops, partial recovery

sre_maya: collecting +1 votes for H1 (eviction policy bug / missed eviction) from me and ash. H2 remains plausible — we increased batch size, which would multiply memory working set. please add any logs that indicate allocation patterns.

eng_runtime_lee: I'm uploading a kvcache dump and per-request allocation traces (stripped PII) to the GCS path now. Also attaching a short grep result for allocation churn:```text
[08:12:05] alloc: 1.2GiB (kv_insert)
[08:12:05] alloc: 512MiB (batch buffer)
[08:12:06] alloc: 768MiB (kv_insert)
[08:12:07] free: 128MiB (evict)
```

ops_patricia: stepping in for handoff at 08:25 UTC. I'll continue mitigation and coordinate with infra. ash handing off incident to patricia.

oncall_ash: handing off to patricia. leaving notes in the incident doc. good win on the canary rollback. :thumbsup:

incident_bot: Handoff recorded: from oncall_ash -> ops_patricia @ 3955554500.

- eng to prepare patch to default batch_size and add guard in rollout to prevent simultaneous batch+eviction policy changes
- sre to instrument kvcache eviction counters with per-session attribution (so we can see which tenant keys produce growth)
- ops to draft mitigation runbook for similar future spikes (include quick rollback command + gcs path for logs)
